claims.text: Interactions: ⍉P-gp inducers (eg, RIF), which lower dabigatran levels;
claims.quote: The concomitant use of PRADAXA with P-gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) reduces exposure to dabigatran and should generally be avoided
claims.locator: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

claims.text: P-gp inhibitors raise levels, esp w renal impairment.
claims.quote: P-gp inhibition and impaired renal function are the major independent factors that result in increased exposure to dabigatran
claims.locator: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

claims.text: Counseling: swallow capsules whole w a full glass of H2O;
claims.quote: PRADAXA Capsules should be swallowed whole. PRADAXA Capsules should be taken with a full glass of water.

claims.text: breaking, chewing or emptying them raises exposure.
claims.quote: Breaking, chewing, or emptying the contents of the capsule can result in increased exposure

claims.text: Don't stop early: premature discontinuation raises thrombotic risk.
claims.quote: Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including PRADAXA, increases the risk of thrombotic events.
claims.locator: WARNING: (A) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF PRADAXA INCREASES THE RISK OF THROMBOTIC EVENTS, and (B) SPINAL/EPIDURAL HEMATOMA
